description.value: A family-owned German restaurant established in 1975, The Black Forest sits on the Esplanade in Harrison Hot Springs overlooking Harrison Lake, about 10 km off Highway 1. It specialises in authentic schnitzel, pork hock, bratwurst, and housemade spaetzle, and is widely regarded as one of the area's standout dining destinations. A heated patio with lake views makes it a rewarding stop after a day on the bike.

address.value: 180 Esplanade Ave, Harrison Hot Springs, BC V0M 1K0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active, family-owned German restaurant at 180 Esplanade Ave., Harrison Hot Springs (not Chilliwack as the OSM community field suggests). Online Ordering is explicitly offered, supporting a takeout claim. Vegetarian pasta and gluten-free beer options appear in the menus; no bike-specific infrastructure (racks, charging, pump) is mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Chilliwack' but the restaurant is located in Harrison Hot Springs; the full postal address (V0M 1K0) and website text confirm Harrison Hot Springs. OSM addr tags lack a city field so this may be a directory-system classification error rather than an OSM error.
One Google review (4 years ago) mentions 'Paid parking outside but not too many spots' — no bike parking is mentioned anywhere in the website or OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, actively operating fine-dining restaurant with lake views in a popular cycling-accessible tourist village; a touring cyclist would find it a worthwhile and memorable meal stop.
